label: Electricity
description: Instruments governing electricity generation, networks, markets and prices.

label: Energy and climate
description: Economy-wide energy, fuel, transport and climate instruments that affect energy demand, supply or prices.

label: Supply chain and industrial policy
description: Instruments on the manufacture of clean energy technologies, investment in manufacturing, and the supply of critical minerals.

label: Trade
description: Border measures that affect clean energy technologies and their inputs: tariffs, trade remedies, import requirements and export restrictions.
